bio: Eldest son of Justice Henry Tuthill (1665-1750) and Bethia Horton (granddaughter of William Wells and of Barnabas Horton). Grandfather of Anna Tuthill Symmes, so great-grandfather of First Lady Anna Symmes Harrison. His father was a brother of John's ancestor John Tuthill Jr, so he is a 1st cousin 10 times removed of John.
sources: [R4-S1] Lucy D. Akerly, The Tuthill Family of Tharston, Norfolk Co., England, and Southold, Suffolk Co., New York (1898) (archive.org full text), pp. 8-9 (secondary) https://archive.org/details/tuthillfamilyoft00aker
